group_order: first appearance in CALIBRATION_CONTROL_TEST_PREDICTIONS.csv; groupby sort=False
bootstrap: Sample 214 source groups with replacement; keep all windows in each sampled group; same group draws across contrasts and estimands.
window_estimand: sum of paired squared-error differences divided by number of resampled windows
source_estimand: mean of within-source mean squared-error differences over sampled sources
interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles; descriptive unadjusted intervals, not a new confirmatory testing family
conditioning: Stored fitted models, fixed observations and archived probabilities; no fitting uncertainty or external-source validation.
calibration: Existing calibrators and convex weights are not refitted; test outcomes are not used for fitting or threshold selection.

reliability.source_weights: Each window has weight 1/n_source computed over the whole cohort; restrict these weights within each bin.
reliability.empty_bins: Omitted from plots; retained with NA averages in CSV.
reliability.small_bins: Fewer than 20 windows or 5 source groups; marked and not merged.
reliability.intervals_per_bin: Not estimated; reliability curves remain descriptive.

claim: Brier/ECE comparisons do not demonstrate improved classification, equivalence or practical moderation benefit.
